source: ISO 273 medium H13 (lib/standards/holes.csv); position Ø0.6 at MMC to A the fixed leaf's mounting face (y = 0), B the pin's axis, C the plane z = 0 at mid-length (ASME Y14.5 floating fastener, T <= H − F = 6.6 − 6 = 0.6)
note: design choice: 2 x M6 in each leaf 25 from the pin's axis, staggered (2.0): the fixed leaf's at z +-28, the moving leaf's at z +-8, so the heads never meet folded to 180; for the button head screws (ISO 7380-1; the inventory's made_of screw-iso7380 x4, a common part not built yet: the holes are modelled, the part placed later); the tapped or through holes in the door and the frame are the hosts'
Ø6 through the two fixed knuckles: the Ø6 pin is pressed in (the fixed leaf, its knuckles and the pin are one body); no fastener and no standard size
Ø7 through the moving leaf's knuckle: 0.5 clear round the Ø6 pin, so the leaf turns free; no fastener and no standard size
